models.backend_reproducibility: Provider-managed route. Gemini cannot disable reasoning, so low is its lowest enabled setting. Requests above the 20 MB provider body limit fall back to a receipted H.264 crf18 encoding. Provider frame sampling is not observed.

Provider-managed route (Alibaba); exact serving revision is not exposed. Reasoning cannot be disabled through OpenRouter, so low is the lowest enabled setting. Alibaba rejects videos with fewer than four frames, which would affect 876 of 2,684 sequence questions, so sequences are sent as ordered image_url parts.
Provider-managed route requiring an account age attestation.

Reasoning cannot be disabled (reasoning tokens are produced even with enabled=false), so low is the lowest enabled setting. OpenRouter routes this model to third-party hosts that vary per request (Parasail, Venice, Friendli were observed); the serving backend is not pinned.

Reasoning is disabled with reasoning.enabled=false, which yields zero reasoning tokens. OpenRouter routes this model to third-party hosts that vary per request (Parasail, Venice, Friendli were observed); the serving backend is not pinned.

Pinned to openai/gpt-5.6-luna rather than the moving alias ~openai/gpt-luna-latest, which resolved to it on 2026-09-14. OpenAI models accept images but not video, so sequences are sent as ordered image_url parts. Reasoning is disabled with reasoning.enabled=false (zero reasoning tokens). Served by OpenAI through OpenRouter.

Pinned to openai/gpt-6-astra, served by OpenAI through OpenRouter. Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint; the endpoint also accepts minimal, so low is a chosen setting rather than the lowest enabled one. Images only, so sequences are sent as ordered image_url parts.

Pinned to openai/gpt-5.6-sol rather than the moving alias ~openai/gpt-sol-latest. Served by OpenAI through OpenRouter. Images only, so sequences are sent as ordered image_url parts. Reasoning is disabled with reasoning.enabled=false (zero reasoning tokens).

Provider-managed route. Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite ships with thinking off by default; low is requested through OpenRouter's reasoning parameter to match the Gemini 3.8 Flash declaration. Requests above the 20 MB provider body limit fall back to a receipted H.264 crf18 encoding. Provider frame sampling is not observed.

Reka Edge is a 7B non-reasoning model; OpenRouter lists no reasoning parameter for it, so reasoning.enabled=false is declared for symmetry and is a no-op. Provider-managed route; serving backend is not pinned. Requests above the 20 MB provider body limit fall back to a receipted H.264 crf18 encoding.

Open weights served by third-party hosts through OpenRouter (Darkbloom, Parasail observed); the serving backend is not pinned. Video requests exclude the Alibaba route, which rejects clips under four frames. Reasoning is disabled with reasoning.enabled=false (zero reasoning tokens observed). Replaces the self-hosted Modal sweep of the same weights, which ran under the archived 512 guard.

Thinking cannot be disabled on Opus 5.5, so reasoning is set to its lowest effort, low, through OpenRouter's reasoning.effort. Served by Anthropic through OpenRouter.
